arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-hygiene-final.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 3 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = e0bd29c5136b32a02e6513df8e87648b6a3d355f
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,subprocess
checks={
'README_CODEX.md':'32159b7425aec45a1fa2a8283528297f45d30fc22ab03b70d857e8b9c87968e2',
'codex/tests/test_coordination_contract.py':'5d64f483fbd7fda9e79dc200ff8bec84c6ce0673f1e47f1024bd54b127053b27'}
for path,digest in checks.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'POSTMERGE_SHA256_CHANGED '+path
 print('POSTMERGE_BLOB_MATCH',path,flush=True)
assert not Path('codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py').exists()
assert not Path('codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py').exists()
assert Path('AGENTS.md').exists() and Path('CODEX_COORDINATION.md').exists()
print('SINGLE_COORDINATOR_CODE_AND_RETIRED_RELAY_CONFIRMED',flush=True)
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
print('POSTMERGE_TRACKED_FILE_COUNT',len(tracked),flush=True)
print('HISTORICAL_CONTROL_RECORDS_PRESERVED',sum(p.startswith('.project-leader/') for p in tracked),flush=True)
PY
python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_coordination_contract -q
echo POSTMERGE_POLICY_REGRESSION_PASS
python3 -m unittest tests.test_trusted_gate -q
echo POSTMERGE_TRUST_REGRESSION_PASS
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo POSTMERGE_REA_CLEAN_VERIFIED
